_readme: FIRST SERVICE — Home to Senthur Motors, Dharapuram.
Scaffolded from the route and purpose only; everything else is yours to fill.
STILL TO FILL:
1. created  — DONE (22 Aug 2026). This is what fixes the vlog's place in
the list (oldest first), so leave it alone from here.
2. video    — paste any YouTube link (youtu.be/…, /shorts/…, watch?v=…).
Empty is fine: the page still renders and says the video is
still to come.
3. duration / views — typed by hand. Blank hides each badge.
4. description — anything in [square brackets] is a prompt, not copy. The
odometer reading and the bill are the two things a first-
service write-up is actually read for.
5. images   — drop frame grabs in public/mygarage/vlog/images/ (a
first-service/ subfolder keeps it tidy) and list them as
'mygarage/vlog/images/<file>'. While empty, the Frame Grabs
section does not appear.
6. videos / instagram / posts — extra clips, reel links, blog slugs. Empty
means those sections stay off the page.
THE ROUTE comes from rideId below, which points at
public/mygarage/rideandroute/r6-home-to-dharapuram-first-service.json. The
stop coordinates in that file are APPROXIMATE — check them on a map.
THE BILL belongs in garage.config.json → maintenance.services, not here —
that is what the Service & Maintenance section reads.
SAFE TO DELETE: any field you don't want. Empty arrays and blank strings
just remove that part of the page — nothing breaks.
